records.jp: …………勇希、出てきて。<CR>もう逃げる場所はないよ
records.en_original: ...Show yourself, Yuki. You've got nowhere else to run.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Show yourself, Yuki. You've got nowhere else to run.
records.en: ...Come out, Yuki.<CR>There's nowhere left to run.

records.jp: ……どうするの？<CR>あたしのこと、殺す？
records.en_original: ...What will you do? Are you going to kill me now?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What will you do? Are you going to kill me now?
records.en: ...What will you do?<CR>Kill me?

records.jp: そうすれば、消滅機構も襲ってこなくなるかもね。<CR>ま、たぶんそんな甘くないんだろうけど
records.en_original: The System may stop going after you then. Though I doubt it would be so simple.
records.en_auxiliary: The System may stop going after you then. Though I doubt it would be so simple.
records.en: Maybe then the erasure mechanism will stop attacking you.<CR>Though I doubt it would be that simple.

records.jp: ねえ、悲しいと思わない？<CR>あたし、死んじゃったんだよ？
records.en_original: Don't you think it's sad? I died, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you think it's sad? I died, you know?
records.en: Don't you think that's sad?<CR>I died, you know?

records.jp: …………あたし、悔しいよ
records.en_original: ...It's not fair.
records.en_auxiliary: ...It's not fair.
records.en: ...It is so unfair.

records.jp: なんであたしが死ななくちゃいけないんだよ
records.en_original: Why did I have to die?
records.en_auxiliary: Why did I have to die?
records.en: Why did I have to die?

records.jp: なんであたしばっかり<CR>こんな辛い思いしなくちゃいけないんだよ！！
records.en_original: Why was I the only one who had to suffer?!
records.en_auxiliary: Why was I the only one who had to suffer?!
records.en: Why was I the only one<CR>who had to suffer like this?!

records.jp: あたしだってみんなみたいに、<CR>いっぱい友達と遊んだりしたかった！
records.en_original: Why couldn't I go out and play with my friends like everyone else!
records.en_auxiliary: Why couldn't I go out and play with my friends like everyone else!
records.en: I wanted to play with lots of friends<CR>just like everyone else!

records.jp: 普通の女子高生みたいなことだって<CR>たくさんしてみたかった！！
records.en_original: All I wanted was a normal life! I had so much I wanted to do!
records.en_auxiliary: All I wanted was a normal life! I had so much I wanted to do!
records.en: I wanted to do all sorts of things<CR>ordinary high school girls get to do!!

records.jp: ……でも、できなかった。<CR>あたしはその想いを抱えたまま死んだ。そう思った
records.en_original: But I didn't get to... That's how I felt when I died.
records.en_auxiliary: But I didn't get to... That's how I felt when I died.
records.en: ...But I couldn't.<CR>I died with all those feelings still inside me. Or so I thought.

records.jp: そんなあたしに、ようやくチャンスが巡ってきた！
records.en_original: And then I finally got a chance at a do-over!
records.en_auxiliary: And then I finally got a chance at a do-over!
records.en: Then at last, I got another chance!

records.jp: みんなを危険に晒そうが知ったこっちゃない！<CR>もともとあたしは死んでるんだ！
records.en_original: So why should I care about the danger I put you all in?! I'm already dead anyway!
records.en_auxiliary: So why should I care about the danger I put you all in?! I'm already dead anyway!
records.en: I don't care if I put all of you in danger!<CR>I was dead to begin with!

records.jp: だから、あたしは――あたしのために生きるっ！！<CR>
records.en_original: I finally got the chance to live my life! Why should I throw it away?!
records.en_auxiliary: I finally got the chance to live my life! Why should I throw it away?!
records.en: So I'll—I'll live for myself!!<CR>

records.jp: …………何か、言ったら？
records.en_original: ...Why don't you say something?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Why don't you say something?
records.en: ...Aren't you going to say something?

records.en_original: *Sigh*....
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*....
records.en: *Sigh*...

records.jp: よくもまあ、そんなに悪人ぶって
records.en_original: You make a good villain.
records.en_auxiliary: You make a good villain.
records.en: You really are committed to playing the villain...

records.jp: 本当にあんたは、飽きれるくらい口が回るね
records.en_original: But aren't you tired of pretending?
records.en_auxiliary: But aren't you tired of pretending?
records.en: You can talk your way around anything. It's almost impressive.

records.jp: 私、言ったよね。嘘は無しだって
records.en_original: Didn't I tell you? I don't want anymore lies.
records.en_auxiliary: Didn't I tell you? I don't want anymore lies.
records.en: I told you. No more lies.

records.jp: 全部教えてって、そう言ったよね
records.en_original: Tell me everything.
records.en_auxiliary: Tell me everything.
records.en: I said to tell me everything, didn't I?

records.jp: こ、これがあたしの本心だよ！！
records.en_original: Th-this is the truth!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-this is the truth!
records.en: Th-this is how I really feel!!

records.jp: そんなわけないでしょっ！！
records.en_original: I don't believe you!
records.en_auxiliary: I don't believe you!
records.en: There's no way that's true!!

records.jp: そうやって嘘ばっかりついて！！<CR>なんで全部誤魔化そうとするんだよッ！！
records.en_original: Stop lying to me! Why are you so intent on twisting everything?!
records.en_auxiliary: Stop lying to me! Why are you so intent on twisting everything?!
records.en: All you do is lie!<CR>Why do you try to hide everything?!

records.jp: あ、あたしは――
灰病のことを隠してまで、<CR>私のことを考えてくれたのは勇希じゃんっ！！
records.en_original: You're the kind of person who would hide her sickness to protect someone she cares about!
records.en_auxiliary: You're the kind of person who would hide her sickness to protect someone she cares about!
records.en: You cared enough about me<CR>to hide your Ash Syndrome, Yuki!!

records.jp: 私は知ってるんだよ！　勇希が人に優しいこと！！<CR>その優しさは絶対に嘘なんかじゃないってことも！
records.en_original: I know just how kind of a person you are, Yuki! And I know it was true!
records.en_auxiliary: I know just how kind of a person you are, Yuki! And I know it was true!
records.en: I know! I know how kind you are, Yuki!<CR>And I know that kindness was never a lie!

records.jp: 私はっ！！
records.en_original: I—
records.en_auxiliary: I—
records.en: I—

records.jp: 本当の、勇希が知りたいんだよ……
records.en_original: I want to know the real you...
records.en_auxiliary: I want to know the real you...
records.en: I want to know the real Yuki...

records.jp: な、なんで…………
records.en_original: Wh-why...?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-why...?
records.en: Wh-why...?

records.jp: もう、いいじゃん。<CR>あたしのことなんてほっといてよ……！
records.en_original: Haven't you had enough? Why won't you just leave me alone?!
records.en_auxiliary: Haven't you had enough? Why won't you just leave me alone?!
records.en: Enough.<CR>Just leave me alone...!

records.jp: 見捨ててよ！　しつこいんだよッ！！<CR>あたしはもう、死人なんだから……っ！！
records.en_original: Just leave me! Why do you have to be so persistent?! I'm already dead!
records.en_auxiliary: Just leave me! Why do you have to be so persistent?! I'm already dead!
records.en: Abandon me! Stop being so persistent!!<CR>I'm already dead...!

records.jp: そうすれば、みんなだって、<CR>助かるかもしれないのに……
records.en_original: If you leave me behind, you might be able to save yourselves...
records.en_auxiliary: If you leave me behind, you might be able to save yourselves...
records.en: Then maybe<CR>all of you could be saved...

records.jp: ねえ、勇希。<CR>私、ちょっとしたことに気づいたんだ
records.en_original: Yuki? You know, I just realized something.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki? You know, I just realized something.
records.en: Hey, Yuki.<CR>I just noticed something.

records.jp: 勇希はここに来たこと、ないよね？
records.en_original: You've never been here before, have you?
records.en_auxiliary: You've never been here before, have you?
records.en: You've never been here before, have you?

records.jp: は……？　何言ってんの……？
records.en_original: Wh-what are you talking about...?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what are you talking about...?
records.en: Wh-what are you talking about...?

records.jp: ココロトープは、<CR>思い出の中の大切な景色をもとに作られた世界だよね
records.en_original: The Heartscapes are made up of important places from our memories.
records.en_auxiliary: The Heartscapes are made up of important places from our memories.
records.en: A Heartscape is a world<CR>formed from important places in someone's memories, right?

records.jp: でもね。これまでの思い出が正しければ……<CR>勇希は生前、展望台には来てない
records.en_original: But, if what you said was accurate...that would mean that you never went to an observation deck like this when you were alive.
records.en_auxiliary: But, if what you said was accurate...that would mean that you never went to an observation deck like this when you were alive.
records.en: But if all the memories we've seen are accurate...<CR>you never visited this observation deck while you were alive.

records.jp: そ、そうだ。私は……<CR>結局、勇希と星を見る約束は、果たせなくて――
records.en_original: Th-that's right... Yuki and I were never able to stargaze together...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's right... Yuki and I were never able to stargaze together...
records.en: Th-that's right. I...<CR>never managed to keep my promise to watch the stars with Yuki—

records.jp: なのに、このココロトープには展望台がある
records.en_original: But there's an observation deck right here in her Heartscape!
records.en_auxiliary: But there's an observation deck right here in her Heartscape!
records.en: And yet there is an observation deck in this Heartscape.

records.jp: それってさ――
records.en_original: Doesn't that mean—
records.en_auxiliary: Doesn't that mean—
records.en: Doesn't that mean—

records.jp: 今ここにいる勇希が、伶那さんのココロトープで<CR>見た景色を忘れられなかったからなんじゃないの？
records.en_original: The Yuki in this world couldn't forget the stars she saw in Rena's Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: The Yuki in this world couldn't forget the stars she saw in Rena's Heartscape.
records.en: Could it be because the Yuki who's here now couldn't forget<CR>the view she saw in Rena-san's Heartscape?

records.jp: いつか一緒に見ようねって約束した星空が<CR>心に残ったから、この世界が生まれたんじゃないの？
records.en_original: You finally got to see the stars with Rena like you promised. Isn't that why this is here?
records.en_auxiliary: You finally got to see the stars with Rena like you promised. Isn't that why this is here?
records.en: Could this world have been born because the starry sky<CR>you promised to see together stayed in your heart?

records.jp: だからね、勇希。<CR>隠しても分かっちゃうんだ――
records.en_original: You can try to hide it, but we can tell.
records.en_auxiliary: You can try to hide it, but we can tell.
records.en: So, Yuki.<CR>Even when you hide it, we can tell—

records.jp: 勇希は今も昔も、変わらずずっと……<CR>伶那さんのことを想ってるんだよ
records.en_original: Past or present, you're always, always thinking about Rena.
records.en_auxiliary: Past or present, you're always, always thinking about Rena.
records.en: Your feelings haven't changed, now or then...<CR>You've always loved Rena-san.

records.en_original: Ah...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah...
records.en: Ah...

records.jp: なんで……なんでそんな、優しいんだよ……！
records.en_original: Why... Why are you being so nice to me...?!
records.en_auxiliary: Why... Why are you being so nice to me...?!
records.en: Why... Why are you being so nice to me...?!

records.jp: ……あんたが世界システムの<CR>一部だろうがなんだろうが関係ない
records.en_original: ...I don't care if you're a part of the World System.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I don't care if you're a part of the World System.
records.en: ...I don't care whether you're part<CR>of the World System or anything else.

records.jp: 勇希は勇希だ！
records.en_original: You are you!
records.en_auxiliary: You are you!
records.en: Yuki is Yuki!

records.jp: 私の大切な……愛する人、金城勇希なんだ。<CR>理由なんて、それしかないんだよ
records.en_original: You're the one I love most in this world... Yuki Kinjou. Nothing else matters.
records.en_auxiliary: You're the one I love most in this world... Yuki Kinjou. Nothing else matters.
records.en: You're my precious... beloved Kinjou Yuki.<CR>That's the only reason I need.

records.jp: 違うんだよ……っ
records.en_original: You're wrong...
records.en_auxiliary: You're wrong...
records.en: That's not it...!

records.jp: あたしは、<CR>みんなが思うほどいいやつじゃない！！
records.en_original: I'm not a good person like you think!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not a good person like you think!
records.en: I'm not<CR>as good as you all think I am!!

records.jp: あたしが生きてても、<CR>みんなに迷惑かけるだけなのに！！
records.en_original: My existence is what caused you all this trouble!
records.en_auxiliary: My existence is what caused you all this trouble!
records.en: If I stay alive,<CR>I'll only cause trouble for everyone!!

records.jp: 勇希
records.en_original: Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki.
records.en: Yuki.

records.jp: 悪者だっていい。世界システムの一部だからって、<CR>これまでの思い出がなくなるわけじゃない
records.en_original: We don't care if you're a bad guy, or if you're part of the World System. None of that changes the memories we made together.
records.en_auxiliary: We don't care if you're a bad guy, or if you're part of the World System. None of that changes the memories we made together.
records.en: I don't care if you're a villain. Being part of the World System<CR>doesn't erase the memories we've shared.

records.jp: 消滅機構が来るなら全員で倒してやる！<CR>勇希を見捨てるなんて絶対にしない！
records.en_original: If the anti-virus wants to come after us, I say we let them! We're never going to abandon you.
records.en_auxiliary: If the anti-virus wants to come after us, I say we let them! We're never going to abandon you.
records.en: If the erasure mechanism comes, we'll all take it down together!<CR>We'll never abandon you!

records.jp: みんなも、そうでしょ
records.en_original: Isn't that right, everybody?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't that right, everybody?
records.en: Everyone feels the same, right?

records.jp: 当然だよ
records.en_original: Of course.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course.
records.en: Of course.

records.jp: みんな……っ
records.en_original: Everyone...?
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone...?
records.en: Everyone...!

records.jp: ごめん……あたし、ふっと記憶が蘇ってきて、<CR>こんなの、どうすればいいか分からなくて……
records.en_original: I'm sorry... Once my memories started coming back, I had no idea what to do...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry... Once my memories started coming back, I had no idea what to do...
records.en: I'm sorry... My memories suddenly came rushing back,<CR>and I didn't know what to do...

records.jp: もう、みんなと一緒にいられないんだって思ったら、<CR>突然視界が真っ暗になって……
records.en_original: When I thought about how I couldn't be with everyone anymore, everything turned black...
records.en_auxiliary: When I thought about how I couldn't be with everyone anymore, everything turned black...
records.en: When I thought I couldn't stay with everyone anymore,<CR>everything suddenly went black...

records.jp: そしたら、こんなことになってて……<CR>でも、一人で死ぬ勇気なんてなくて……
records.en_original: And that's how things wound up like this... But in the end I was still scared to die alone...
records.en_auxiliary: And that's how things wound up like this... But in the end I was still scared to die alone...
records.en: Then I found myself here...<CR>But I didn't have the courage to die alone...

records.jp: <CR>だから、みんなの敵になるしかないと思って……<CR>そうすれば殺してくれるって思ったのに……
records.en_original: Then I thought if I could turn you all against me, I wouldn't have to do it myself...
records.en_auxiliary: Then I thought if I could turn you all against me, I wouldn't have to do it myself...
records.en: <CR>So I thought I had no choice but to make you all my enemies...<CR>I thought that would make you kill me...

records.jp: でも、嫌だよ…………っ
records.en_original: But I don't want this...
records.en_auxiliary: But I don't want this...
records.en: But I don't want to...!

records.jp: ずっと、このまま……<CR>みんなと、伶那と一緒に、いたいよ……
records.en_original: I don't want to die... I want stay here with everyone, with Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't want to die... I want stay here with everyone, with Rena...
records.en: I want to stay like this forever...<CR>with everyone—with Rena...

records.jp: 助けて、伶那…………っ
records.en_original: Rena... Please, help me.
records.en_auxiliary: Rena... Please, help me.
records.en: Help me, Rena...

records.jp: やっと、言ってくれた
records.en_original: You finally said it.
records.en_auxiliary: You finally said it.
records.en: You finally said it.

records.en_original: Rena...?
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...?
records.en: Rena...?

records.jp: 勇希は……一見おっちょこちょいで、<CR>何事にも楽観的で、適当に見えて――
records.en_original: When I first met you, I thought you were a klutz, oppressively positive, and careless...
records.en_auxiliary: When I first met you, I thought you were a klutz, oppressively positive, and careless...
records.en: Yuki... At first glance, you're clumsy,<CR>optimistic about everything, and seem careless—

records.jp: でも実は、誰よりも周りのことを見てて、<CR>それを全部抱え込んで、嘘で誤魔化そうとする
records.en_original: But in truth, you care more for the people around you than anyone else. You try and protect them by not telling them the full truth.
records.en_auxiliary: But in truth, you care more for the people around you than anyone else. You try and protect them by not telling them the full truth.
records.en: But really, you pay more attention to everyone around you than anyone,<CR>take it all on yourself, and try to hide it with lies.

records.jp: 私、やっと……勇希のこと、分かったよ。<CR>本当の気持ち、教えてくれてありがとう
records.en_original: Thank you for telling me your true feelings... I understand now.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you for telling me your true feelings... I understand now.
records.en: I finally... understand you, Yuki.<CR>Thank you for telling me how you really feel.

records.jp: 大丈夫、全部任せて。<CR>私が、みんなが――今度こそ絶対に、勇希を助ける！
records.en_original: Just leave it all to me. This time I, along with everyone here, will save you!
records.en_auxiliary: Just leave it all to me. This time I, along with everyone here, will save you!
records.en: It's okay. Leave everything to me.<CR>I—and everyone—will definitely save you this time!

records.jp: うん！　勇希を救って……<CR>ついでに世界も救っちゃいますか！
records.en_original: Yeah! First we save Yuki, then we save the world!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! First we save Yuki, then we save the world!
records.en: Yeah! We'll save Yuki...<CR>and save the world while we're at it!

records.jp: 私たちにできないことなんてない。そうでしょ？
records.en_original: As long as we're together, there's nothing we can't do! Remember?
records.en_auxiliary: As long as we're together, there's nothing we can't do! Remember?
records.en: There's nothing we can't do. Right?

records.jp: みんなぁ……っ
records.en_original: You guys...
records.en_auxiliary: You guys...
records.en: You guys...

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続を確認しました。<CR>世界構築の安定性低下に注意してください
records.en_original: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en_auxiliary: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en: Fragment reconnection confirmed.<CR>Caution: world-construction stability is declining.

records.jp: ……ごめん
records.en_original: ...I'm sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm sorry.
records.en: ...I'm sorry.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: It's okay.
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: ごめんね……
records.en_original: I'm so sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so sorry...
records.en: I'm so sorry...

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: I know. It's okay.
records.en_auxiliary: I know. It's okay.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: 伶那……
records.en_original: Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...
records.en: Rena...

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: It's okay, I promise.
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay, I promise.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: 大好きだよ
records.en_original: I love you.
records.en_auxiliary: I love you.
records.en: I love you.

records.jp: 私も
records.en_original: I love you, too.
records.en_auxiliary: I love you, too.
records.en: Me too.

records.jp: あの時からずっと変わらない。<CR>嘘つきだけど誰よりも優しい、あなたが好き――
records.en_original: You may have lied, but it's never been to hurt someone... You haven't changed a bit.
records.en_auxiliary: You may have lied, but it's never been to hurt someone... You haven't changed a bit.
records.en: That hasn't changed since that day.<CR>I love you. You may be a liar, but you're kinder than anyone—
